about.welcomeSubtitle: An all-in-one crochet platform built for anyone who loves making things by hand.
about.storyP1: We created Len&Em because learning crochet often means jumping between videos, online stores, and community groups. It can feel overwhelming, especially for beginners.
about.storyP2: Len&Em brings everything together—from learning your first stitch to completing your first handmade project—in one place.
about.coreValuesSubtitle: Learning, shopping, and creating should feel simple, enjoyable, and connected.
about.learnDesc: Easy-to-follow lessons designed for every skill level.
about.shopDesc: Find the exact materials recommended in every lesson without searching elsewhere.
about.diyDesc: Share your creations, inspire others, and discover new ideas from fellow makers.
about.seamlessDesc: Lessons, materials, and inspiration—all connected in a single experience.
about.healingDesc: Crochet is more than a craft. It's a creative way to slow down and enjoy your time.
about.connectionDesc: Connect with creators and handmade enthusiasts who share your passion.
about.teamSubtitle: We're building a place where anyone can discover the joy of handmade creativity.
about.ctaSubtitle: Let Len&Em be part of your next handmade journey.
